results.content:
TOWN OF WINCHESTER

REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS

The TOWN OF WINCHESTER is seeking responses from qualified firms/individuals to provide professional services associated with the Reconstruction of Symmes Corner – 25% Engineering Design Project. Responses must be received at the Town Manager’s Office, Attn: Brian Wyncoop, 71 Mt. Vernon Street, Winchester, MA 01890, on or before 10 AM, October 29, 2026.

The Town of Winchester will award the contract to the responsible and responsive proposer whose Qualifications Proposal is determined to be most advantageous to the Town based on the evaluation criteria set forth in this RFP. The Town of Winchester reserves the right to reject any or all proposals to ensure the best value and outcome for the Town. [...] Proposers may obtain sets of bid contract documents starting on October 7, 2026. Copies may be obtained for pickup at the Winchester Town Manager’s Office, located at 71 Mt. Vernon St., Winchester, MA, beginning October 7, 2026, as follows: Monday’s 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Tuesday’s, Wednesday’s & Thursday’s 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., and Friday’s 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 Noon, or by emailing: bwyncoop@winchester.us . Addenda will be sent via email to all plan holders that have registered with the Town Manager’s office.

Questions regarding the RFP must be written and e-mailed to bwyncoop@winchester.us .

Brian Wyncoop

Procurement Administrator

# News Flash

# Request for Future Use Proposal - Old Town Hall, 417 Longmeadow Street

The Town of Longmeadow is issuing this Request for Future Use Proposal (RFUP) to solicit creative concepts, expressions of interest, and preliminary proposals for the future adaptive reuse, purchase, or lease of Old Town Hall located at 417 Longmeadow St

\Town Updates (News and Events)   Posted on October 06, 2026

Town of Longmeadow

231 Maple Road

Longmeadow, MA 01106

## REQUEST FOR FUTURE USE PROPOSAL (RFUP) [...] ### 5. SELECTION & EVALUATION CRITERIA

This RFUP is non-binding and serves as an information-gathering tool to inform the Select Board. However, responses will be evaluated based on:

1. Financial and operational sustainability of the proposed concept.
2. Responsiveness to resident input and enhancement of the surrounding area.
3. Sensitivity to the historic integrity of 417 Longmeadow Street.
4. Extent to which the proposal relieves the Town of the ~$800,000+ renovation/maintenance cost burden.

### 6. TIMELINE & SUBMISSION CALENDAR

Pre-Submission Questions/Inquiries Due: October 30, 2026

1. Request for Future Use Proposal Submission Deadline: November 19, 2026
2. Task Force Review: November, 2026
